content.text:
The researcher wants uni_owns_nonexclusive_licence and 30-day review. I want company_owns and 90-day review. I can trade: accept uni_owns_option_to_assign (compromise on IP) and push for 60-day review. Or accept the IP model but get 60 days review.

I can change at most two fields. Let me move IP to uni_owns_option_to_assign (better than non-exclusive licence for us) and reviewDays to 60.
